links.outcome: LLM-generated rehabilitation plan quality versus senior physiatrist plans, blinded expert ratings
links.effect: Grok-4 (mean 4.31), Gemini-2.5-pro (4.14) and Deepseek-r1 (3.69) significantly outperformed human benchmark (3.56); Claude-opus-4 (3.50) did not differ significantly.
links.quote: Quantitative analysis revealed that Grok-4 (mean 4.31) and Gemini−2.5-pro (mean 4.14) significantly outperformed the human benchmark (derived from standardized expert solutions) (mean 3.56; [Formula: see text]).

screen.reason: The study conducts an offline multi-dimensional benchmark evaluating LLMs against human experts on authentic clinical cases in rehabilitation medicine, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
